question: Find the ANTONYM of the word ‘unparalleled’
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. **'Frequent'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unparalleled (अद्वितीय/अतुल्य)** - Having no parallel or equal; exceptional.

 
 
• **Example:** She displayed **unparalleled** skills in the musical concert.
 
 
 
• **Frequent (अक्सर)** - Occurring or done many times at short intervals.
 
 
• **Example: **His **frequent **trips to the library helped him gain deep knowledge about the subject.
 
 
 
• From the above example, '**Frequent' **is the antonym of **'Unparalleled'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is ***'Frequent'***. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Devastation (विनाश) **- Great destruction or damage.

 
 
• **Example: **The war left a trail of devastation across the country.
 
 
 
• **Barrier (बाधा) **- A fence or other obstacle that bars advance or access.
 
 
• **Example: **Language should not be a barrier to communication.
 
 
 
• **Strategies (रणनीतियाँ) **- A plan of action designed to achieve a long-term or overall aim.
 
 
• **Example:** The company adopted new marketing strategies to boost its sales.
 
 

8f:T52c,
The correct answer is Option (3).</str
